tickets.title: Prepare manual transfer package for joint taxable account
tickets.text: Prepare a manual transfer package for Lena and Colin Copperwisp’s joint taxable account at Silver Marmot Brokerage to Velvet Acorn Custody. Preserve the in-kind transfer instruction for the taxable holdings after Silver Marmot Brokerage rejected the automated transfer request due to an account number format mismatch.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that a manual package preserving the in-kind transfer instruction for the taxable holdings would be prepared, due 2024-08-02.

tickets.title: Resolve Lena Copperwisp’s identity verification upload loop
tickets.text: Help Lena Copperwisp resolve the repeated upload loop for her new Velvet Acorn Custody registration identity verification. The receiving registration is conditionally open because the identity check was not fully cleared. Lena asked the firm to resolve the issue rather than asking her to resubmit the same identification through the portal again.
tickets.evidence: Lena asked Apricot Compass Advisory to help resolve the repeated upload loop rather than asking her to resubmit the same identification through the portal again; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-07-31.

tickets.title: Confirm cost basis import settings for concentrated stock lots
tickets.text: Coordinate with Velvet Acorn Custody to confirm cost basis import settings for the low-basis Pocket Lantern Robotics shares in Lena Copperwisp’s transferred lots. Ensure the lots are not booked as unidentified positions.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to coordinate with Velvet Acorn Custody so the transferred lots are not booked as unidentified positions, due 2024-08-06.

tickets.title: Obtain trust certification or trustee authority document
tickets.text: Obtain an acceptable trust certification or equivalent trustee authority document for the Copper Firefly Revocable Trust to support Lena and Colin Copperwisp’s taxable account registration at Velvet Acorn Custody. The receiving custodian still needs this document before the registration can be finalized.
tickets.evidence: the receiving custodian still needs an acceptable trust certification or equivalent trustee authority document before the registration can be finalized; this remains needed, with a 2024-08-05 date.

tickets.title: Start Lena Copperwisp’s Velvet Acorn Custody rollover IRA setup
tickets.text: Start the Velvet Acorn Custody rollover IRA setup for Lena Copperwisp’s Pocket Lantern Robotics 401(k) assets following her employment separation. Coordinate direct-rollover instructions after plan access is confirmed.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to start the Velvet Acorn Custody rollover IRA setup and coordinate direct-rollover instructions after plan access is confirmed, due 2024-08-09.

tickets.title: Reconcile Colin Copperwisp’s inherited IRA owner name
tickets.text: Reconcile the owner name mismatch on Colin Copperwisp’s inherited IRA at Silver Marmot Brokerage with the draft receiving paperwork before submitting another transfer request. Resolve the titling discrepancy to prevent rejection of the inherited IRA registration.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the titling before submitting another transfer request so the inherited IRA registration is not rejected, due 2024-08-07.

tickets.title: Obtain Colin Copperwisp’s inherited IRA statement
tickets.text: Obtain a current statement for Colin Copperwisp’s inherited IRA at Silver Marmot Brokerage showing the inherited IRA registration. The receiving custodian requested the statement, but Colin’s online access did not display the needed document during the call.
tickets.evidence: obtaining the statement remains needed, with a 2024-08-04 date.

tickets.title: Track household account transfer sequence against fee-change timing
tickets.text: Track the transfer sequence for Lena and Colin Copperwisp’s main household accounts against the client-imposed timing target of moving them before Silver Marmot Brokerage’s announced household service fee increase.
tickets.evidence: they agreed to track the transfer sequence against that client-imposed timing target, due 2024-08-23.
